milestone: R178 FPS + INTERIORS + STRATEGIC COMMAND FOUNDATION

identity.policy: Do not create new gameplay architecture that depends on the temporary codename. Do not perform an unsafe global rename until the governed rebrand milestone. Donor project names never become runtime authority.

donors.role: behavior, data, content-contract and acceptance-scenario donor
donors.rule: Harvest selected mature behavior into current owners; never restore Gameplay/Runtime/Server donor trees wholesale.

donors.role: locomotion, state-machine and historic implementation donor
donors.rule: Use only where it improves the current Subspace owner and passes current certification.
GitHub main outranks uploaded snapshots whenever they differ.

canonicalOwners.resourceIdentity: ResourceMaterialSystem (requires later versioned NullHarbor vocabulary migration)

controlDomains.FirstPerson: Character locomotion and world/interior interaction only.
controlDomains.FleetStrategy: Strategic camera, selection and order issue only; WASD must never produce vessel thrust.
controlDomains.DockedService: Docked/hangar interaction context; direct flight suppressed.
controlDomains.Transit: Cinematic/vector transit; direct player movement suppressed.

fleetCommandPolicy.newBehavior: orders remain blocked/pending/active until an authoritative domain executor reports real progress/completion/failure

interiorGridContract.rule: Room planning, structural modules and detailed kitbash placement are separate layers. Free placement is opt-in for tagged props/greebles.

kitbashPolicy.promotion: source intake -> provenance -> normalized derivative -> sockets/collision -> visual review -> runtime proof -> promoted runtime asset

migrationDebt.resourceVocabulary: Legacy Avorion-era material IDs still require versioned compatibility mapping; do not search/replace save IDs.
migrationDebt.projectStatusMetadata: Legacy pass/version prose is historical and must not outrank Git HEAD + quality gate + generated project status.
migrationDebt.liveApplicationIntegration: NativeGameApplication must consume the contextual router and authoritative fleet adapters without reintroducing duplicate control lanes.

invariants: Donor behavior may be absorbed; donor architecture may not become a parallel authority.
Historical InputAction numeric indices remain stable; new semantic actions append only.
FleetStrategy never writes vessel thrust/fire intent.
First-person interior collision remains derived from the current certified interior shell.
Source art never decides gameplay room semantics directly.
Ship and station interiors share the module/socket/portal vocabulary while retaining different layout grammars.
No content pack name is hard-coded as the only valid interior implementation.
A fleet order cannot complete solely because elapsed time passed.
